cell.reason: Needs a free FRED API key in config.json.

provenance.source_name: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
provenance.cadence: Varies by series, daily through quarterly.
provenance.reliability: Aggregator, not originator. FRED republishes other agencies’ data.
provenance.caveat: FRED mirrors a source with its own lag. For anything time-critical, check the originating agency.
provenance.quality_meaning: No data. Either the source needs a key or it has no free feed at all.

insights.reason: Needs a free FRED API key in config.json.

impact.meaning: A RISE in this series pushes mortgage rates UP. A fall pushes them DOWN.

chains.chain: Retail sales → ↑ Growth expectations → ↑ 10Y Treasury → ↑ MBS yield → ↑ 30Y mortgage rate
rationales: MBS are priced off the Treasury curve. This is the main channel.
Lenders price off MBS execution, with a short lag for rate sheets.
